reports.summary: Loads Percy's main NIB and remains alive on Windows after resolving its archived navigation-bar classes, but does not display usable game content because the navigation-controller hierarchy is not restored.
milestones: Loaded the armv6 app and completed MainWindow NIB class resolution past the previously fatal UINavigationBar and UINavigationItem boundary.
Created a 480x320 window, initialized the audio session, requested the preferred language, and remained alive through a controlled 17-second observation.
Accepted a close request sent only to the spawned tapHLE window and exited without a Rust panic or forced termination.
reports.blocker: UINavigationController does not restore the archived view-controller stack and parent-child relationships, so it falls back to an empty plain UIView and no guest EAGL frame is submitted.
reports.notes: The full Archive.org metadata, content hashes, embedded identity, and tapHLE --info verification passed immediately before the clean exact-commit release run. The binary identified itself as 1ae13a34 and used bundled default options in a fresh sandbox. A requested guest-frame capture produced no EAGL frame. A separate process-owned 480x320 desktop capture was black but is not standalone rendering evidence because desktop OpenGL capture can be unreliable; the blocker classification also relies on the logged empty UIView fallback and absence of any submitted guest frame.

reports.summary: Reaches Percy's playable pipe board on Windows with the restored navigation/modal hierarchy, drawable OpenGL storage, decoded PCM effects, and deterministic tile input.
reports.blocker: Full controls, saving, and every game mode have not yet been validated.
milestones: Restored the archived navigation-controller stack and modal Level1 -> LevelIntro -> InGame route.
Captured an internal guest frame showing the portrait board, textured background, grid, and OPEN control.
Delivered a controlled tile tap that reached the game's tile-rotation logic.
Decoded Percy's AIFF and CAF PCM effects, including CAF data with a nonzero edit-count field.
reports.notes: The exact Archive artifact was verified immediately before this release build. Desktop OpenGL screenshots may appear black; the internal guest-frame capture is the authoritative rendering check. Full controls, saving, and all game modes remain unvalidated.

reports.summary: A clean Windows release build renders Percy's Instructions screen, returns safely to the main menu, reaches the Level 1 pipe board, and visibly rotates a selected pipe tile.
reports.blocker: Level completion, the remaining controls and levels, saving, other game modes, and long-session stability have not yet been validated.
milestones: Rendered the archived Instructions text, font, color, bullet, and spacing without the earlier string or font decoder crashes.
Used the Instructions Main Menu control to pop the view controller and return to a framebuffer identical to the known-good main menu.
Repeated the Main Menu -> Level 1 -> Level Intro -> In Game route and captured the live portrait board.
Captured the same randomized board immediately before and after a controlled tap at (148,172), proving that the selected pipe tile changed orientation.
reports.notes: The exact Archive original was reverified against its published MD5 and SHA-1, the recorded SHA-256, embedded bundle identity, and tapHLE --info immediately before this clean run. The release binary identified itself as ad6d2ccd. Repeated state-aware captures covered both the presented UIKit menu path and submitted EAGL gameplay frames. The process remained alive without a panic until the controlled harness stop. Audio was confirmed on the exact ancestor report and heard again during the equivalent pre-commit compatibility run; the final automated capture route did not independently measure audibility.
